name: com.spicapost/spica-post
title: Spica Post
description: Draft, schedule and publish social posts across brands via MCP with approvals, analytics & links.

tools.name: accounts_list
tools.description: The social accounts connected to this workspace: each one’s id, network, name, status and any active queue hold (heldUntil, holdKind, holdReason). Drafts are written for these ids. An account whose status is disconnected has to be connected again on the user’s account page before anything can be posted to it.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: accounts_connect
tools.description: Links to connect or reconnect social accounts per network, plus current status. For each ready network, hand over `directLink` first (single-use, 15 min, see `expiresAt`, skips Spica sign-in; for Bluesky it opens a handle + app-password form noted in `how`). Keep `link` (account page) as fallback. Ready: false means not connectable yet (say so). When `open` names a guide, read it with help_get for users without an account yet. Changes nothing.

network.description: One network by its key in capabilities, such as "instagram". Leave it out for every network that can be connected.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: What each network takes here: the longest caption and how it is counted, which file types, how many files (and whether a post needs one), and whether it has stories. Read it before writing for a network.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: tiktok_account_get
tools.description: What one connected TikTok account allows, read from TikTok now: the visibility levels TikTok offers it (before TikTok’s audit, only Only me), whether the account has comments, duets or stitches switched off, and the longest video it may post. Use it to draft sensibly (a video under the limit) and to explain the choices the owner will make. Read only: who can see a TikTok post and how people may interact with it are chosen by the owner on the TikTok screen, never by you or the API (TikTok’s content sharing guidelines). Changes nothing.

accountId.description: A connected TikTok account id from accounts_list.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: drafts_list
tools.description: Every draft in the workspace, with its current version and the link that opens it in the user’s composer.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: drafts_get
tools.description: One draft: its title, its version and the text and media for each account. mediaRemovalAt, when present, is when its files will be removed if the draft is left unposted.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: drafts_create
tools.description: Create a draft with a title and one variant per account (publishes nothing). Check with drafts_validate and get user approval before publish or schedule. For TikTok accounts, the owner must set visibility and interaction choices on the screen linked in `choose`: hand over that link and never send TikTok choices here.

title.description: Internal draft name (up to 200 characters); never posted.

text.description: Caption within the network limit (see capabilities); empty for a story. On YouTube, line 1 is the title.

mediaIds.description: Ordered media ids from media_upload_link, media_upload, media_list or templates_render; empty for text-only.

kind.description: Omit for a normal post; "story" sends 1 photo/video to an Instagram or Facebook story with empty text.

visibility.description: YouTube (ask user: public, unlisted or private; defaults to public if unset) or Mastodon visibility.

documentTitle.description: LinkedIn PDF title, 1 to 200 characters. Defaults to the filename without its extension.

firstReply.description: First reply/comment under the post: X (280), Threads (500), LinkedIn (1250), Instagram or Facebook Pages (2200).

threadPosts.description: 1 to 24 chained follow-up replies on X, Threads, Bluesky or Mastodon.

board.description: Pinterest board name or id (see boards_list); defaults to the account board.

link.description: Pinterest https destination URL (defaults to first URL in caption).

type.description: Google Business Profile post type: update (default), offer or event.

options.description: Optional per-network settings (never send for TikTok: owner chooses via choose link). Also accepts Instagram (collaborators, tags, cover, reelsOnly, trial, aiGenerated), X (thread), Threads (quotePostId, replyToId), Mastodon (spoilerText, language), YouTube (videoTags, containsSyntheticMedia, publishAt), Pinterest (cover), and Google Business Profile (language, button, title, start, end, offer); see capabilities.

variants.description: One entry per target account with its caption, mediaIds and optional network options.

tags.description: Up to 10 campaign tags (e.g. "spring-launch") for Results grouping and UTM {tag}; never posted.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: drafts_edit
tools.description: Replace a draft’s title and variants using the last-read version (409 on conflict: re-read via drafts_get). Queued posts keep their snapshot. Editing a TikTok variant’s text or video clears prior TikTok screen choices (re-share `choose` link).

version.description: Draft version last read; mismatched versions are refused.

title.description: Internal draft name (up to 200 characters); never posted.

text.description: Caption within the network limit (see capabilities); empty for a story. On YouTube, line 1 is the title.

mediaIds.description: Ordered media ids from media_upload_link, media_upload, media_list or templates_render; empty for text-only.

kind.description: Omit for a normal post; "story" sends 1 photo/video to an Instagram or Facebook story with empty text.

visibility.description: YouTube (ask user: public, unlisted or private; defaults to public if unset) or Mastodon visibility.

documentTitle.description: LinkedIn PDF title, 1 to 200 characters. Defaults to the filename without its extension.

firstReply.description: First reply/comment under the post: X (280), Threads (500), LinkedIn (1250), Instagram or Facebook Pages (2200).

threadPosts.description: 1 to 24 chained follow-up replies on X, Threads, Bluesky or Mastodon.

board.description: Pinterest board name or id (see boards_list); defaults to the account board.

link.description: Pinterest https destination URL (defaults to first URL in caption).

type.description: Google Business Profile post type: update (default), offer or event.

options.description: Optional per-network settings (never send for TikTok: owner chooses via choose link). Also accepts Instagram (collaborators, tags, cover, reelsOnly, trial, aiGenerated), X (thread), Threads (quotePostId, replyToId), Mastodon (spoilerText, language), YouTube (videoTags, containsSyntheticMedia, publishAt), Pinterest (cover), and Google Business Profile (language, button, title, start, end, offer); see capabilities.

variants.description: One entry per target account with its caption, mediaIds and optional network options.

tags.description: Up to 10 campaign tags (e.g. "spring-launch") for Results grouping and UTM {tag}; never posted.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: drafts_validate
tools.description: Check a draft against the rules of every network it goes to. Answers valid, errors as plain sentences that say what to fix, and optional warnings when multiple accounts on one network share the exact same caption, when a caption or topic repeats a recent post, or when an optional proposed scheduledAt breaks workspace calendar pacing rules. ask, when present, lists what the user has not chosen yet and what happens if they do not (a YouTube video’s visibility): ask them, then set it with drafts_edit. Changes nothing. publish and schedule run the same check and refuse a draft that fails it. A TikTok post is not valid until the owner has made TikTok’s choices on the TikTok screen; choose lists the link to that screen for each TikTok account still waiting. Give the user the link; do not try to choose for them.

version.description: Draft version last read; mismatched versions are refused.

scheduledAt.description: Optional proposed UTC schedule time ending in Z to preview whether it triggers any workspace calendar pacing rules.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: drafts_delete
tools.description: Delete a draft, and with it each of its files that no other draft uses. Refused with 409 while one of its posts is queued or not yet confirmed. Posts already made stay in the history.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: drafts_hold
tools.description: Keep a post for a network the user has not connected yet, with its pictures, so it is not lost with the conversation. It shows on their account page next to that network’s Connect button, and becomes a draft by itself, for the new account, when they connect it. Use it only while accounts_list has no connected account for that network; otherwise write a draft with drafts_create. Up to 10 posts can wait. Answers the kept post and every post now waiting.

network.description: The network it is for, by its key in capabilities, such as "facebook". It must have no connected account yet.

text.description: The post, up to 20000 characters and within what that network takes (post_check says).

title.description: A short name for it, up to 200 characters. Left out, its first line is used.

topicId.description: The topic it was written for, from topics_add. The draft is tied to that topic when the post becomes one.

mediaIds.description: The pictures or videos that go with it, by their ids (from templates_render, media_upload or media_from_url), within what that network takes. They are kept while the post waits and go into the draft with it.

id.description: A waiting post from an earlier drafts_hold, to replace its words. Leave it out to keep a new post.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Post a draft now to every account in it. Call it only after the user said yes to this post. Answers one delivery per account in state queued, which means accepted, not posted: read jobs_get for the outcome and the link to the live post. One call counts as one post on the plan.

version.description: Draft version last read; mismatched versions are refused.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key (8 to 200 chars, e.g. UUID). Reusing it after a timeout returns the same jobs and never double-posts.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: schedule
tools.description: Queue a draft to post at a later time, to every account in it. Call it only after the user said yes to this post and this time. Answers one delivery per account in state queued; a warning on a delivery means that account’s connection will lapse before then and the user should reconnect it. Refused when the time is further ahead than the plan schedules (usage_get says how far).

version.description: Draft version last read; mismatched versions are refused.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key (8 to 200 chars, e.g. UUID). Reusing it after a timeout returns the same jobs and never double-posts.

scheduledAt.description: Future UTC timestamp ending in Z (e.g. 2026-11-06T14:00:00Z), converted from the workspace time zone (see usage_get).

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: queue_add
tools.description: Queue a draft for the next free posting time, to every account in it, without choosing a date. Call it only after the user said yes to this post; tell them the time it was given. The time is the next of the saved posting times at which none of the draft’s accounts already has a post and every active workspace pacing law (queue_rules_get) passes. Answers one delivery per account in state queued, with its scheduledAt. Refused when no posting times are saved yet (queue_set) or when every slot in the plan horizon is taken or blocked by pacing rules.

version.description: Draft version last read; mismatched versions are refused.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key (8 to 200 chars, e.g. UUID). Reusing it after a timeout returns the same jobs and never double-posts.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: jobs_query
tools.description: Filter deliveries by state, failure kind, network, accountId, draftId or UTC time range, capped at limit (default 30), with total count, network, machine-readable kind and plain-language action guidance on failed or held rows. Use this instead of jobs_list in busy workspaces. Changes nothing.

state.description: Filter to one delivery state. When "queued", results sort soonest first; otherwise newest first.

kind.description: Filter failed or unknown deliveries by failure kind: paused_by_network, daily_limit, login_ended, media_rejected, identity_check, email_unconfirmed, link_blocked, maybe_published or other.

network.description: Filter to one network key, such as "x", "linkedin" or "instagram".

accountId.description: Filter to one account id from accounts_list.

draftId.description: Filter to deliveries created from one draft id.

since.description: Return deliveries at or after this UTC ISO timestamp.

until.description: Return deliveries at or before this UTC ISO timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum deliveries to return (1 to 100). Defaults to 30.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: content_calendar_get
tools.description: A day-by-day content calendar in the workspace’s own time zone (1 to 31 days, default 14): every scheduled, published and failed post with its local time, saved queue slots, open queue slots and empty-day counts. Use it to spot gaps and pick times accurately. Changes nothing.

from.description: Start calendar date in the workspace time zone, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

days.description: How many consecutive calendar days to return (1 to 31). Defaults to 14.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: results_get
tools.description: Performance over the last 7, 30 or 90 days (Studio, Pro and Agency): post totals vs previous period, engagementRate, byKind format breakdown, daily trend, per-network and campaign byTag rollups, topic and content-pillar rollups for posts linked via topics_link (byTopic, byPillar), top 5 posts, bestTimes, hashtags, shortLinks clicks, audience followers/growth, sync status, and failed-delivery counts by kind (failures). Filter via source ("all", "spica", "native") or tag. If sync.accountsSynced < sync.accountsEligible, run results_sync once to pull full account history. Includes `google` (Google Business Profile calls, directions, websiteClicks, views; null if unconnected) and `searchConsole` (Google Search Console clicks, impressions, ctr, position, queries, pages) when connected. Changes nothing.

days.description: How far back to look: 7, 30 or 90 days. 30 when left out.

source.description: Which posts to include: "all" (Spica + synced native posts, default), "spica", or "native".

tag.description: Optional campaign tag such as "spring-launch" to filter metrics and top posts to that campaign.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: jobs_get
tools.description: One delivery and its outcome. state is queued (carries held: true, holdKind, heldUntil and action while its account is paused or awaiting reconnect), provider_accepted (the network has it and is still processing), published (receipt.url is the live post), failed (error says why, kind classifies the cause and action names the next step), unknown (kind is maybe_published: check the profile before sending again) or cancelled.

id.description: A delivery id from publish, schedule or jobs_list.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: jobs_cancel
tools.description: Cancel one delivery that is still queued. Refused with 409 once it is being sent or has been sent. Each account of a post is its own delivery, so cancel each one that should not go out.

id.description: A delivery id from publish, schedule or jobs_list.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: jobs_reschedule
tools.description: Move one delivery that is still queued to another time in the future. Refused with 409 once it is being sent or has been sent. Each account of a post is its own delivery.

id.description: A delivery id from publish, schedule or jobs_list.

scheduledAt.description: Future UTC timestamp ending in Z (e.g. 2026-11-06T14:00:00Z), converted from the workspace time zone (see usage_get).

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: media_upload_link
tools.description: Create a one-time upload link for PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP4 or LinkedIn PDF files (prefer this over base64 media_upload for generated or phone files). PUT bytes with Content-Type without sign-in, or hand the link to the user to upload; then check media_list (newest first). Default: 1 file, 1 hour; pass multiple: true or maxFiles 2 to 20 for a 24-hour dropzone. Prefer JPEG (Instagram rejects PNG/WebP).

name.description: A file name for the user’s own list. Taken from the file when left out.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for people who cannot see it. Kept with the file.

multiple.description: true opens a 24-hour multi-file dropzone for up to 20 files instead of a one-file 1-hour link.

maxFiles.description: Maximum files this link accepts (1 to 20). Values from 2 to 20 stay open for 24 hours; 1 ends after 1 hour.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: media_from_url
tools.description: Add one file by its public web address: PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP4 or LinkedIn PDF, up to 10 MB. The service fetches it once and stores it; answers its media id, as media_upload does. Use it when the user points at a file that is already online. Refused when the address is not a public https one, cannot be fetched, is too large, or leads to a page instead of a file.

url.description: The https address of the file itself, one that opens the file in a browser without signing in. Not the address of a page that shows it.

name.description: A file name for the user’s own list. Taken from the address when left out.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for people who cannot see it. Kept with the file.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: usage_get
tools.description: What the plan includes and what is used this month: posts, accounts and uploads, the workspace time zone, when the month ends, and the latest time a post can be scheduled for right now. Check it before queuing a batch.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: workspace_overview
tools.description: A single-call briefing of this workspace: brand readiness, connected, held and lapsed accounts, plan usage, posting queue, recent drafts, waiting posts, upcoming and recently failed deliveries, content counts (topics, articles, link pages, media kit, auto-replies, locations, custom fonts) and an attention list of what needs action right now. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: post_check
tools.description: Would each network take this post? Give the text, the networks and mediaIds or counts of photos, videos and PDFs; answers for each network whether it is ready, what is wrong, and the length used against the limit. Needs no draft and changes nothing.

networks.description: Network keys to check against: x, linkedin, instagram, facebook, threads, bluesky, mastodon, tiktok, youtube, google (Google Business Profile), pinterest.

images.description: How many photos would be attached.

videos.description: How many videos would be attached.

documents.description: PDF count, 0 to 20. LinkedIn takes one alone.

mediaIds.description: Up to 20 library ids instead of counts. Checks actual file sizes and known PDF page counts.

story.description: True to check it as a story instead of a post.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: help_get
tools.description: One help article as plain text, to read out or sum up for the user.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: media_list
tools.description: Every uploaded file, newest first: id, name, type, size and alt text. A file with purgedAt has been removed from storage and can no longer be attached.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: media_view
tools.description: Look at one stored picture of this workspace: the answer is the picture itself. Use it on every picture templates_render made, before showing it to the user: check that no line is cut off, that the words fit their space and that the photo sits well, and render again if not. A video answers with its still picture. A PDF up to 2 MB answers as a document resource. Larger PDFs return file details. Changes nothing.

id.description: A media id from media_upload or media_list.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: setup_start
tools.description: Start here when the user asks to be set up or no brand is saved, and again whenever you have lost your place. Say in can what you can do (open web pages, open the user’s files, look at pictures) and each step is worded for that. Answers where the workspace stands, the short first steps that end in a first post and what to offer after it (each with an id, what to do and whether it is done), which step is next, and the fields of a brand. Changes nothing.

web.description: True if you can open and search web pages yourself, false if you cannot.

files.description: True if you can open the user’s own files or folders, false if you cannot.

pictures.description: True if you can look at a picture and see what is in it, false if you cannot.

can.description: What you can do, so each step is worded for you. Leave it out and the steps are the general ones.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: brands_list
tools.description: The brands this login holds, each with its id and name, and which one a call goes to when it names none (current). Every other tool takes brandId, an id from here: with more than one brand, name it in every call, and tell the user which brand a post is for before they say yes to it. Changes nothing.

tools.name: brand_get
tools.description: The saved brand of this workspace (business, voice, look, offers, what never to say), or null before setup. Read it before writing any post.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: brand_save
tools.description: Save the brand you drafted during setup. Send the whole brand each time: it replaces the saved one. Set confirmed to true only after the user agreed to your summary.

week.description: mon to sun: {open,close} 24h, null, or 3 spans.

templates.description: Up to 12 template ids per format.

brand.description: Full brand object (replaces saved brand except customer-owned brand.owned).

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: topics_add
tools.description: Add a topic to the ledger before writing it: its title, the question or search phrase it is meant to win (keyword), the one product or service it is about (item), how it comes at it (angle) and which of the brand’s topics it belongs to (pillar). A keyword already covered is refused, so the same question is never written twice.

title.description: The topic in a few words, up to 160 characters.

keyword.description: The question or search phrase it is meant to win, up to 120 characters. One already covered is refused.

item.description: The one product or service it is about, up to 120 characters.

angle.description: How the piece comes at it, in a word or two of up to 60 characters: guide, comparison, checklist, story.

pillar.description: Which of the brand’s topics it belongs to, up to 120 characters.

note.description: Anything to remember when writing it, up to 400 characters.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: coverage_get
tools.description: What is covered and what is not: each topic’s standing per network and language, what it still lacks, how many topics each brand pillar has, and the profile questions no topic has taken yet. Call it to choose what to write next.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: playbook_get
tools.description: How to write a post for each network: what one post is, how its caption is built, where a link goes, and the rules every post follows. Read it before writing a set of posts. Without a network it answers for the connected ones.

network.description: One network key, such as instagram. Leave out for every connected network.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: grader_get
tools.description: How to judge a draft before the user sees it: seven scored dimensions for an article, yes-or-no checks for a social post, and what counts as a pass. Judge every piece and fix it until it passes.

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: tools_search
tools.description: Search Spica Post’s full catalog of 170+ tools by keyword or domain group (link pages, blog, templates, inbox, crosspost, auto-repost, Instagram auto-replies, short links, UTM, media kit, keywords, locations, Pinterest boards, batch ops, calendar sync, client reviews, team/approvals, audit, webhooks, exports). Returns exact tool names, safety hints, parameter limits and whether to call directly, via tools_read, or via tools_run. Changes nothing.

query.description: Keyword or task to match tool names, titles, descriptions and groups (e.g. "link page", "blog", "inbox", "template", "webhook", "team").

group.description: Optional domain group name (e.g. "Link page", "Inbox", "Articles", "Templates", "Auto-crosspost", "Approvals and audit", "Webhooks").

includeSchemas.description: Include full parameter lists with types and limits (default true when query or group is provided).

limit.description: Maximum tools to return (1 to 50). Defaults to 15.

tools.name: tools_read
tools.description: Execute any local read-only tool from Spica Post’s extended catalog discovered via tools_search (such as links_list, inbox_list, articles_list, templates_list, brands_overview, approvals_list or export_*). Refuses mutating or external-network tools (use tools_run for those). Changes nothing.

tool.description: Exact local read-only tool name from tools_search (e.g. "links_list", "inbox_list", "articles_list", "templates_list", "brands_overview").

args.description: Arguments matching the target tool’s parameters from tools_search (pass brandId at top level).

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).

tools.name: tools_run
tools.description: Execute any extended tool from Spica Post’s full catalog discovered via tools_search (such as links_save, articles_save, templates_render, inbox_reply, crossposts_save, schedule_batch, team_invite or webhooks_save), with full schema validation, role checks and plan limits. Always confirm with the user before publishing, replying publicly, sending invites or changing live settings.

tool.description: Exact extended tool name from tools_search (e.g. "links_save", "articles_save", "templates_render", "inbox_reply", "schedule_batch", "webhooks_save").

args.description: Arguments matching the target tool’s parameters from tools_search (pass brandId at top level).

brandId.description: Brand id from brands_list (required when the login has multiple brands).
